components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The dominant save or continue action in a field workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--blue, #114ccf); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 850; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 9px 20px rgba(17,76,207,.26); transition: transform .16s ease-out, background .16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark, #0a328f); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #114ccf); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A bordered alternative that stays visibly subordinate to the blue action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #aeb9ca; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0e1830); font-family: var(--font, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 850; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease-out, background .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f0f4fa; border-color: #8290a6; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #114ccf); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: A daylight-readable metadata field with a strong blue focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #0e1830); font-family: var(--font, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid #aeb9ca; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #0e1830); font: inherit; transition: border-color .16s ease-out, box-shadow .16s ease-out; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #7d8ba3; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--blue, #114ccf); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(17,76,207,.14); outline: 0; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #114ccf); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: A compact two-option selector for mutually exclusive field settings.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #aeb9ca; border-radius: 10px; background: #f7f9fc; font-family: var(--font, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-segmented button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #c9d1de; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0e1830); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--blue, #114ccf); color: #fff; } .ds-segmented button:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]) { background: #f0f4fa; } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { position: relative; outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #114ccf); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Local Processing Status
components.description: A compact positive status badge for local or safe processing states.
components.css: .ds-local-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e8f6ef; color: var(--ok, #137a46); font-family: var(--font, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
The system feels like a piece of civic field equipment: daylight white and mineral gray form the work surface, while municipal blue supplies the authority and instant recognition of an enamel address sign. Ink navy keeps information legible without the glare of pure black, and a narrow safety-amber signal marks decisive capture-related moments.

The visual language is dense, direct, and structural. Full-width rails, visible alignment, and compact labels organize information without relying on floating cards. Mildly rounded controls remain practical for touch, while square-cut sign geometry preserves the municipal character. Expression always yields to capture state, metadata legibility, and outdoor contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Municipal blue as the single dominant identity and interaction color.
Daylight-ready contrast with ink navy text on white or mineral-gray surfaces.
Structural rails and shared gutters instead of decorative card stacks.
Compact information density with touch targets of at least 44px.
Square-cut enamel-sign geometry balanced by restrained control rounding.
One purposeful capture-stamp motion moment, with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Municipal blue carries identity and selection; safety amber appears only at capture-related moments or as the address-plate rule, never as generic decoration.

rules.name: The Daylight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Default to ink navy on daylight white and reserve translucent light text treatments for dark image-backed regions with a supporting overlay.

rules.name: The Field-Legibility Rule
rules.body: Use the Chinese system sans stack and tabular numerals for timestamps; core comprehension must never depend on a downloaded font.

rules.name: The Structural Rail Rule
rules.body: Use full-width rails, shared 18px gutters, and visible one-pixel boundaries to establish hierarchy; do not replace them with a stack of detached cards.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Useful Rule
rules.body: Keep working surfaces flat at rest; add elevation only when it clarifies containment, action priority, or legibility over imagery.

rules.name: The Civic Geometry Rule
rules.body: Keep rails and address plates square-cut, controls mildly rounded, and use pills or circles only when their meaning is inherently status- or camera-related.

dos: Do use municipal blue for primary actions, selected states, focus, and the signature address plate.
Do preserve 44px or larger touch targets even when labels and spacing remain compact.
Do align related content to the shared 18px gutter and separate groups with rails, tone, or one-pixel lines.
Do keep the system Chinese font stack and high daylight contrast for offline, outdoor legibility.
Do reserve the capture-stamp animation for the moment an image becomes a committed record and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't scatter safety amber across ordinary controls or secondary decoration.
Don't turn every group into a rounded floating card or add ornamental gradients to working surfaces.
Don't use low-contrast gray for critical state, metadata, or actionable text.
Don't add continuous camera, watermark, or status animation; motion must confirm a state change.
Don't introduce a webfont dependency, oversized display typography, or marketing-style spaciousness into dense field controls.
